channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Channing Frye | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Channing Frye from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Channing Frye, Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Richard Jefferson on thhe group chat dynamics of the 2016 Cavs:

“When we talk about the group chat from the team, there's like six of us, and it's been the same six. There was the full team group chat, then there was the guys that were J.R., Swish, Tristan, Kevin, Channing, and Bron. So that's the group of us. And then we start doing, hey guys, we should get together, do some golf and go do this, and then a conversation kind of got started is, and like, hey, it would be wrong if we didn't invite some of the other guys because it's going to look like, we're calling it this championship. No, it was the group chat from the championship team, not the championship team group chat.”

Richard Jefferson on Channing Frye, Tristan Thompson, Jun 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kevin Love on Channing Frye
item.description:
Kevin Love:

“I don't want to make it seem like I was this great guy that came in and sacrificed right away. It was tough for me initially to do that because I didn't have a great veteran until the triangle came along, which was you and Channing, that helped change my life in that way.”

Kevin Love on Channing Frye, Jun 8, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Richard Jefferson, Channing Frye
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:LeBron, on the @RoadTrippinPod with Allie Clifton, Richard Jefferson and Channing Frye:

“I ain’t high-fivin’ nobody for the rest of my life after this.”

LeBron James on Richard Jefferson, Channing Frye, Mar 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Kevin Love on Channing Frye
item.description:
He told The Athletic he didn’t take another drink for two weeks.

“The Channing retirement (bar) tour was not good for my internal organs,”

Kevin Love on Channing Frye, May 3, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kevin Love on Channing Frye
item.description:
Rick Noland:Love on Frye:

“He always found a way to keep it light while also knowing there's a bigger picture”

Kevin Love on Channing Frye, Apr 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: Kevin Love on Channing Frye
item.description:
Rick Noland:Love on Frye:

“He encompasses all the right things -- the spirit of the game, our culture, just everythingChanning is about on and off the floor”

Kevin Love on Channing Frye, Apr 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: Luke Walton on Channing Frye
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Luke Walton on coaching former Arizona teammate Channing Frye:

“He was a freshman when I was at U of A. I’ve been yelling at him for years.”

Luke Walton on Channing Frye, Feb 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: David Griffin on LeBron James, Channing Frye, Trevor Ariza, Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Griffin told ESPN this week.

“We were concerned what would it look like for him because Kyrie had been really active with us in recruiting everybody that was going to come if LeBron didn't come. And was very successful as a recruiter. [Gordon] Hayward wanted to come, Chandler Parsons would have come, Channing Frye would have come, Trevor Ariza would have come. Like, we had an opportunity to get everybody, and he had done a great job for us. So there was a little bit of trepidation on our part of, 'Is he going to feel like we've asked him to go backwards?' And from the very beginning, it was like, 'Griff, all I want to do is win.' So he's been very receptive to it.”

David Griffin on LeBron James, Channing Frye, Trevor Ariza, Chandler Parsons, Jun 1, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Richard Jefferson, Kyle Korver, Channing Frye
item.description:
Celtics'Brad Stevens:

“Korver, Frye, Jefferson, those guys were playing the right way up 45 freaking points. Tremendous examples for us.”

Brad Stevens on Richard Jefferson, Kyle Korver, Channing Frye, May 20, 2017. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Channing Frye
item.description:
Adam Lauridsen:Steve Kerr on Channing Frye:

“He's one of my favorite people in the league. ... He's definitely attracting a lot of our attention in terms of gameplan.”

Steve Kerr on Channing Frye, Jun 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @GSWFastBreak.

item.title: David Griffin on Channing Frye
item.description:
Rick Noland:David Griffin on Channing Frye:

“We're not getting him to be a defensive stopper. ... (But) he's not a non-defender”

David Griffin on Channing Frye, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: Robert Sarver on Channing Frye
item.description:
Sarver told the radio station.

“He had mentioned he was interested in coming back, and then when he was talking to Orlando, he just called and said, 'Hey, you've got three minutes to match this offer.' And we just let him go. To be honest with you, Channing was a good piece of what we did, but I think we're better off now without him because it allows these younger guys to play.”

Robert Sarver on Channing Frye, Mar 3, 2015. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Robin Lopez on Channing Frye
item.description:
Robin Lopez:

“It’s funny, when I was playing in Phoenix, Channing Frye, who had been in Portland, told me if I visited there, if I went there, I was just going to love it. And I was a little reluctant to believe him just because Channing talks a lot of stuff. But it turns out he’s been 100 percent right. I can’t believe how perfectly the fit has been. It’s a bizarre city, I’m weird as hell. It’s a match made in heaven.”

Robin Lopez on Channing Frye, Apr 2, 2014. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Channing Frye, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
With recent focus being placed on whether Kevin Garnett is a dirty player, Ainge suggested that teams and players throughout the league — including the ones Garnett has robbed the right way — would be happy to have him.

“Alvin Gentry wishes that Channing Frye played like Kevin Garnett, would give anything if Channing Frye played with the passion and the heart and the intensity and the work ethic of Kevin Garnett,”

Danny Ainge on Channing Frye, Kevin Garnett, Feb 10, 2011. Source: WEEI.com.
